description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts (support+NEI); one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: A low percentage of hematopoietic progenitor cells are susceptible to HIV-1 infection ex vivo.
Claim 2: All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: A low percentage of hematopoietic progenitor cells are susceptible to HIV-1 infection ex vivo.
All hematopoietic stem cells segregate their chromosomes randomly.
rationale: Sequential administration of 5-chloro-2-deoxyuridine and 5-iodo-2-deoxyuridine indicated that all HSCs segregate their chromosomes randomly.
